news.detail: Ruled out with hamstring injury suffered Week 2 vs Minnesota; first missed start of career.
Cleared concussion protocol Sunday and is available, but serves as backup after missing most of practice week.
Bears going with Case Keenum instead of Bagent as starter; Bagent only if needed.
Expected to start vs Eagles per Rapoport/Glazer; first regular-season snaps since 2023.
Knee issue limited him in practice but he carries no game designation and is good to go.
Ruled out with knee injury; expected to miss multiple games.
Ruled out on the Eagles' final Week 3 injury report.
Elevated from practice squad for this game to help fill Goedert's absence; on track for season debut.
Shares TE snaps with Ertz and E.J. Jenkins in Goedert's absence rather than taking a clear lead role.
Full participant with hamstring issue, no game designation; will play.
Full participant after Week 2 stinger, no game-day designation.
With Caleb Williams out, starting QB could be a game-time decision between Bagent and Case Keenum.
With Goedert out, Mundt is one of three TEs alongside elevated Zach Ertz and E.J. Jenkins; Ertz's role may limit him.
